I = 2 I 0 cos 2 (ϕ 2 )

I = 2 I 0 cos 2 (π 4 )= 2 I 0 × 1 2 = I 0

(A) is true. Reason (R) is correct because the resultant intensity in interference can indeed be the sum of the individual intensities when the phase difference is non-zero.
